articles.summary: USA Compression Partners, LP (TXSE: USAC) (“USA Compression” or the “Partnership”) announced today its financial and operating results for third-quarter 2026. Financial Highlights Total revenues of $357.2 million for third-quarter 2026, compared to $250.3 million for third-quarter 2025. Net income was $47.3 million for third-quarter 2026, compared to $34.5 million for third-quarter 2025. Net cash provided by operating activities was $117.7 million for third-quarter 2026, compared to $75.9 million for third-quarter 2025. Adjusted EBITDA was $197.3 million for third-quarter 2026, compared to $160.3 million for third-quarter 2025. Distributable Cash Flow was $127.1 million for third-quarter 2026, compared to $103.8 million for third-quarter 2025. Distributable Cash Flow Coverage Ratio was 1.67x for third-quarter 2026, compared to 1.61x for third-quarter 2025. Announced cash distribution of $0.525 per common unit for third-quarter 2026, consistent with third-quarter 2025. Operational
articles.title: USA Compression Partners Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results
